plain_text:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Senior Backend Engineer role at TestCo.

Over the past six years, I have built Python and FastAPI services handling 10K+ requests per second. I designed multi-tenant MongoDB indexing patterns and led the migration from a monolith to an event-driven architecture at Acme Corp. My background fits the requirements you've described, especially around multi-tenant SaaS architecture and asyncio expertise.

Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Claude Smoke
